chain: assignment CSV SHA-256 recorded in randomization receipt

assignment_integrity.rule: compiler must reproduce every frozen treatment/colony/profile assignment exactly; treatment-cell or profile mismatch is fatal
assignment_integrity.input_hash: assignment CSV SHA-256 must equal randomization receipt assignments_sha256 before compilation

trial_randomization.global_seed: domain-separated deterministically from the frozen roster randomization seed
trial_randomization.row_order_invariance: sorting/input CSV row order cannot change an individual's trial schedule
within_individual: each four-trial block contains each state exactly once

artifacts: final trial schedule CSV with actual individual and colony IDs
schedule receipt JSON with assignment hash, randomization-receipt hash, derived seed, schedule hash and balance audit

finalization.current_status: actual eligible roster and definitive individuals-per-cell not yet available
required_before_preregistration: final N frozen from GLMM operating-characteristic gate
final schedule compiled from the matching assignment receipt
final schedule SHA-256 inserted into preregistration finalization payload

forbidden: hand-editing final trial schedule after roster randomization
reassigning counterbalance profiles during schedule compilation
using an assignment CSV whose hash differs from the randomization receipt
regenerating schedules with a different seed after outcomes or training performance are observed
treating the generic anonymous schedule builder as the final assigned-individual schedule
claim_ceiling: This gate makes the final trial schedule a deterministic descendant of the frozen eligible roster and randomized assignment. It does not supply the roster, final N, pilot, ethics or preregistration itself.
